description: Both a missing scripted replies file (adapter) and a non-executable configured awk binary (tool) fail preflight at once: the combined error joins both messages with '; ', adapter before tool (preflight's own result order). The missing-replies-file branch's own OS strerror text is third-party, masked by the conformance harness's own message-shape catalogue (tests/conformance/README.md); the errno and the path stay exact.
